metrics_definition.normalization: same conservative zh-ITN, OpenCC t2s, NFKC/casefold and Unicode P/Z/C removal as the two-arm experiment
metrics_definition.entity_hits: Exact normalized canonical substring occurrence, capped by frozen gold multiplicity; no identity linking or alias inference.
metrics_definition.by_type_CER: Whole-transcript CER over recordings that contain the type; it is not error attribution to only that entity type.
metrics_definition.pure_transcript: Pure-ASR raw_text and clean_text are required to be identical; scored once as pure_asr_raw.

design_limits: Pure ASR is a separately collected supplementary run, not a third arm interleaved with the completed context/audio pair collection.

Its private WebSocket is a transparent forwarder to the same ASR service and measures only the raw ASR route; it has no browser/user-proxy time. Existing context/audio timings cover their full Web final path and are not raw-ASR-only timings.
Accuracy differences compare complete mode pipelines; they cannot all be attributed to entity prompting/review alone because pure ASR omits entity assistance, refinement, and numeric processing.
The historical run used 1-second PCM blocks, at most four outstanding blocks, and 2-second ASR chunks; see pure_asr/protocol.json for the recorded run settings when available.
